channel.title: ZUMS Computer Society — Blog
channel.description: Write-ups, ladders and post-mortems from the wings of ZUMS Computer Society.

item.title: Why a computer club should run on failure
item.description: The motto is not decoration. How TRY / FAIL / REPEAT shows up in how we run sessions, pick projects and hand over the panel.

item.title: The ICPC prep ladder we actually used
item.description: Four hundred problems, ordered. What to solve in week one, what to skip until you can prove a complexity bound.

item.title: Building the club site without a framework
item.description: PHP 8, PDO, no build step. Why we chose boring technology for something the next panel has to maintain.
